svg.text: rx_mix: passive double-balanced mixer (one per arm)
four transmission gates (N 8/0.28, P 16/0.28 um): lo connects rfp-bbp and rfn-bbn, lob crosses them; the RF nodes sit at the LNA output DC (~2.5 V), so each switch is a full TG
no DC through the switches (the baseband is high-Z), so no flicker noise; source: sim/rx/rx_mix.py block()
